recognize_zh: 20 倍下以小型成熟淋巴球為主的濾泡中，散在幾個核較大、染色質淡而空泡狀、核形不規則或多葉的細胞，並有一條穿入的小血管；這些核大且不規則的細胞就是發育異常的濾泡樹突細胞（dysplastic FDC），出現在萎縮的生發中心，是透明血管型 Castleman 病的線索。
features: Follicular area dominated by small round mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin
Scattered large cells with enlarged, vesicular, irregular to multilobated nuclei and delicate nuclear membranes (dysplastic follicular dendritic cells)
Occasional binucleate-appearing FDCs with small nucleoli and ill-defined pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Small penetrating capillary with plump endothelial cells within the follicle
Absence of tingible-body macrophages, mitotic activity and centroblast-rich germinal center
describe_en: Lymph node section at higher power shows a follicle composed predominantly of small mature lymphocytes surrounding a lymphocyte-depleted germinal center. Within the germinal center are scattered follicular dendritic cells with enlarged, vesicular, irregular or lobated nuclei, occasional binucleation and indistinct cytoplasm, accompanied by a small penetrating vessel. Tingible-body macrophages and centroblasts are not conspicuous, and no sheets of atypical cells are present. Findings are consistent with a regressed germinal center with dysplastic follicular dendritic cells, as seen in unicentric hyaline-vascular Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: FDC sarcoma shows cohesive sheets or whorls of atypical CD21/CD23/CD35+ spindle cells effacing architecture, rather than scattered dysplastic FDCs within intact follicles.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells have huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ in an inflammatory background, unlike the bland small nucleoli of dysplastic FDCs.
Reactive germinal centers are cellular with centroblasts, centrocytes, mitoses and tingible-body macrophages, with only inconspicuous FDCs.
